rows.role_title: Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: Under the heading 'APPOINTMENT OF DEPUTY PRESIDENT PUMZILE MLAMBO-NGCUKA' (Draft Resolution) the Chief Whip of the Majority Party moved without notice that the House 'notes the appointment today of the Hon Phumzile Mlambo-Ngcuka as Deputy President of the Republic of South Africa' and congratulates her on her appointment; the motion was agreed to. The House met at 14:03.
